title: OutcomeDetailsResource
description: Contains details on the result for a standalone 3DS Authentication.

acs_transaction_id.description: Universally unique transaction identifier assigned by the issuer to identify the transaction.

ares.description: The Authentication Response Message (ARes) is the issuer's response to the AReq message.

cryptogram.description: A 28-character Base64 string proving that 3DS was completed. Store this value securely, and don’t reuse it for multiple authorizations.

eci.description: Electronic Commerce Indicator provided by the issuer to indicate the result of this 3DS Authentication.

protocol_version.description: The 3DS protocol version used for this 3DS Authentication.

requestor_challenge_indicator.description: The indicator provided to the issuer by Stripe in the AReq that indicates whether a challenge is requested for this Authentication. This indicator should match the flow_preference you specified but may be overridden (for compliance reasons for example).

rreq.description: The Results Request Message (RReq) communicates the results of the authentication or verification.

three_ds_server_transaction_id.description: Universally unique transaction identifier assigned by Stripe to identify the transaction.
